title: Rebuild Canvas Character Visual System with High Concept-Art Fidelity (9 Main Characters)
author: Antigravity Senior Technical Artist
objective: Replace uniform stick/capsule character rendering with a data-driven per-character rig, silhouette, layered costume, material, hair, facial, and cloth-physics architecture inside SkeletalRenderer, faithfully translating all 9 official 2D concept arts (assets/images/characters/char_*.png) into the live HTML5 Canvas engine.
requestedBehavior: 1. Unique bone proportions (rig) per character (spine height, shoulder/waist/hip taper, arm/leg lengths, limb bulk, head scale). 2. Multi-layer silhouette-first costume construction (draped overcoats, cyber high-collar trenches, crimson general armor + cape + plume, mountain tunic + woven bamboo back hat, assassin scarf tails + gunmetal shoulder plates, patriarch high-collar robe + wide bell sleeves, sleeveless brawler gi vest, authentic navy-indigo Vovinam gi with gold thigh dragon). 3. Distinct head contours, jawlines, hairstyles, expressions, and custom weapons/props. 4. Smooth secondary cloth motion tied to velocity & combat animations. 5. Preserved combat, hitboxes, animation states, Vovinam skin switching, HUD portraits, and zero regressions across all regression suites.
acceptanceCriteria: All 9 characters are distinctly recognizable in pure black Silhouette Test view
Each character has custom body proportions (height, shoulder/waist ratio, limb lengths/thickness, head scale)
All 9 outfits, hairstyles, faces, accessories, and weapons match their official 2D concept arts (char_*.png)
Secondary cloth/coat/scarf/plume/sleeve/belt motion responds smoothly across idle/walk/run/attack/hurt poses
All Node regression suites and real browser smoke tests pass with 0 errors
